en.intro: Mud logging equipment, sensor selection and configured supply for international oilfield buyers.
about: ChinaMudLogging.com supports international oilfield procurement with equipment selection, sensor sourcing, replacement parts and system configuration review. Our focus is geological evaluation, surface formation evaluation and drilling monitoring.

Start with the measurement and the existing system: range, power supply, signal, connection, operating environment and documentation. We help turn these requirements into a practical request for quotation.

Catalogue entries describe source records and configurations. Manufacturing origin, certification, hazardous-area approval, compatibility, availability and delivery must be confirmed for the specific order.
services: Equipment and sensor sourcing: review the required measurement, installation and operating conditions before proposing a configuration.
Replacement and integration review: compare power, output signals, protocols, process connections and the existing acquisition system.
Quotation and supply coordination: confirm quantity, technical documentation, delivery terms and agreed support. Site work, commissioning and training are included only when explicitly agreed.
privacy: This website uses the information you submit—name, email, company, country, product and requirements—to review and answer your inquiry. Submission records are saved on the website server and a notification may be sent to our business mailbox through the configured mail provider.

We measure page paths, broad traffic sources and inquiry actions with a random identifier in browser session storage for up to 30 minutes. Cloudflare measurement records are retained for up to 90 days. Names, email addresses, company names, requirements, full referrers and query strings are excluded. Browser Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control disable measurement. A reference can link an inquiry action to minimal Zoho delivery evidence; a person must review whether the inquiry is relevant.

WordPress and language selection may use necessary cookies. Hosting security logs may record network information; the form uses a keyed network-address hash for short-lived rate limiting and does not store a raw address in the inquiry record.

Access to inquiry records is restricted to website administrators. We retain records while needed to answer and manage the inquiry. For access, correction or deletion requests, contact sales@chinamudlogging.com. Do not submit passwords, payment information or sensitive personal information.

444.description: Mud logging combines surface examination of drilled cuttings and returning gas with drilling measurements to record formation and wellsite information.
paragraphs: Mud logging builds a surface record of a well during drilling. It combines examination of rock cuttings carried up by the circulating drilling fluid with gas measurements and drilling parameters.
Cuttings recovered at the shale shaker help describe the formations being drilled. Mud gas measurements and operating data add context for geological interpretation and drilling monitoring.
Core samples may supply additional geological information, but collecting core is a separate operation and does not define mud logging.
